subject: File control entry
notes: kb/Work PB781 (wave 1021 B). The RESERVE carrier (FileModel.ReserveAreas, PB1079/PB643) now has its SR12 screen: BindFileControl keeps the RESERVE clause's cursor and, once the whole entry is read (the ORGANIZATION clause may follow RESERVE), refuses RESERVE on a file whose organization is LINE SEQUENTIAL with COBOL2921 at the RESERVE clause. The predicate is LINE SEQUENTIAL itself, not FileModel.IsSequential: RECORD SEQUENTIAL and the omitted clause (12.4.5.10.3 GR6) keep RESERVE (NIST IX4014/SQ2034/SQ2264; positive golden writes and reads all three). Editions 2023 only: below it LINE SEQUENTIAL is refused by its introduction gate (COBOL0900).
